[EN] The {@LinkCreature:20#30011100#morale boosters} keep the slaves working; so get rid of them and the digging should stop.

Once you've taken care of them, head to the Reliquary Station in the Halls of Shadow. They've been asking for reinforcements.

You might find that you're bounced around a bit in here.
[ES] Los {@LinkCreature:20#3011100#morale boosters} mantienen a los esclavos trabajando; así que deshazte de ellos y la excavación debería detenerse.

Una vez que te encargues de ellos, dirígete a Reliquary Station en Halls of Shadow. Han estado pidiendo refuerzos.

Puede que notes que te traen de aquí para allá por estos rumbos.

[EN] Finally! It's good to see they haven't forgotten about us completely.

I hope you don't need to rest, because there's no time for that.
[ES] ¡Por fin! Es bueno ver que no se han olvidado por completo de nosotros.

Espero que no necesites descansar, porque no hay tiempo para eso.
